letter.opening: I am applying for the Senior Frontend Engineer role because the mandate to build frontend as a platform closely matches the work I have led across scalable web, mobile, and real-time products.
letter.profile_intro: I bring 9+ years of frontend experience with React, TypeScript, state management, accessibility, performance, and end-to-end architecture ownership. At HARMAN, I designed a modular micro-frontend architecture with Rspack Module Federation and built shared foundations for React and React Native applications.

achievements.impact: Built a centralized component library covering forms, charts, cards, inputs, and error states, reducing overall development time by 40%.
Designed a parent-and-child micro-frontend model with shared feature integration and TypeScript-first standards.
Used Sentry, Datadog, New Relic, Grafana, Firebase monitoring, and Jest to support performance, observability, and code quality.

letter.closing: OpenFX's focus on shared components, micro-frontends, frontend observability, and a Banking SDK is a strong fit for my experience. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how I can help establish these foundations and make product teams faster.
